qualification.reason: This document is a Request for Proposals (RFP) issued by the City/County Association of Governments of San Mateo County for a planning project. It includes a clear procurement solicitation with deadlines, submission instructions, scope of work, evaluation criteria, and budget details.

quotes.quote:
REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS 
 San Mateo Countywide Safe Streets for All Supplemental Planning
Proposals are due: January 23, 2026, 12:00PM PST

The City/County Association of Governments of San Mateo County (C/CAG), a Joint Powers Agency composed of the County of San Mateo and all twenty cities located within San Mateo County, invites qualified consultants to submit proposals for San Mateo Countywide Safe Streets for All Supplemental Planning Project, which is funded through the U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT) Safe Streets for All (SS4A) Grant Program.
Proposals must be received by C/CAG no later than 12 PM PST on Friday, January 23, 2026, in accordance with the instructions contained in the RFP.
C/CAG has budgeted four hundred thirty-three thousand, one hundred forty-one dollars ($433,171) for this effort.
IV. PROPOSAL REQUIREMENTS
V. PROPOSAL EVALUATION

findings.title: Public Records Act Indemnification
findings.fact: By submitting materials, proposer consents to release of materials under the Public Records Act and agrees to indemnify and hold harmless C/CAG for release of such information.
findings.business_implication: Bidder may be liable for costs associated with release of its own information.
findings.action_recommendation: Be aware of potential indemnification obligations; consider marking confidential information (though waiver is broad).

quotes.quote: By submitting materials, (1) you consent to release of such materials by C/CAG if requested under the Public Records Act without further notice to you, and (2) you agree to indemnify and hold harmless C/CAG for release of such information.

findings.title: Contract Term Duration Discrepancy
findings.fact: The RFP states the anticipated contract term is approximately 48 months, but also states the total contract duration shall be four (4) years. These are consistent, but the schedule indicates completion by June 30, 2030, which is more than 48 months from April 1, 2026 (50 months).
findings.business_implication: There may be a slight inconsistency in the contract duration versus the completion date.
findings.action_recommendation: Clarify the exact contract end date with C/CAG.

quotes.quote: The anticipated contract term will be approximately 48 months.
The total contract duration shall be four (4) years; however, the e-bike white paper deliverable shall be completed and submitted for final approval no later than December 31, 2026.
The schedule shall be based on an anticipated project kick-off during the week of April 1, 2026, and shall demonstrate completion of all work no later than June 30, 2030.

findings.title: Waiver of Public Records Protection and Indemnification
findings.fact: Submission of any materials in response to this RFP is itself a public record without exception. Submission of any materials in response to this RFP constitutes a waiver by the submitting party of any claim that the information is protected from disclosure. By submitting materials, (1) you consent to release of such materials by C/CAG if requested under the Public Records Act without further notice to you, and (2) you agree to indemnify and hold harmless C/CAG for release of such information.
findings.business_implication: The bidder waives confidentiality protections for its proposal and agrees to indemnify C/CAG for any release of information, potentially exposing the bidder to liability if third parties claim damages from disclosure.
findings.action_recommendation: Review the indemnification clause carefully and consider limiting the scope of indemnification in the contract negotiation phase.

quotes.quote: Also, all information submitted in response to this RFP is itself a public record without exception. Submission of any materials in response to this RFP constitutes a waiver by the submitting party of any claim that the information is protected from disclosure. By submitting materials, (1) you consent to release of such materials by C/CAG if requested under the Public Records Act without further notice to you, and (2) you agree to indemnify and hold harmless C/CAG for release of such information.

findings.title: Evaluation Criteria and Weights

findings.business_implication: The bidder must prioritize the highest-weighted criteria (Staff/Firm Qualifications and Understanding of Scope) to maximize score.
findings.action_recommendation: Allocate proposal effort to thoroughly address the top-weighted criteria with strong evidence of qualifications and scope understanding.

findings.fact: Indicate if the proposing consultant is or was involved with any litigation in connection with prior projects. If yes, briefly describe the nature of the litigation and the result.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must disclose any litigation history, which may affect evaluation.
findings.action_recommendation: Prepare a litigation history disclosure and be ready to explain any past litigation.

findings.title: Proposal Page Limit
findings.fact: Each submittal shall be no more than 20 pages, excluding cover letter, title page, table of contents, resumes of key staff members, relevant experience, and references. All required appendices and forms are excluded from the 20 page limit unless otherwise specified.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must carefully manage the page count to stay within the limit.
findings.action_recommendation: Plan the proposal structure to comply with the page limit.

findings.title: Unsigned Proposals Rejected
findings.fact: Unsigned proposals or proposals signed by an individual not authorized to bind the prospective consultant will be considered nonresponsive and rejected.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must ensure the proposal is properly signed by an authorized individual.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify that the proposal is signed by an authorized signatory before submission.

findings.fact: Any proposals received prior to the time and date specified above may be withdrawn or modified by written request of the consultant. To be considered for the project, however, a modified proposal must be received prior to January 23, 2026.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must submit any modifications by the specified deadline.
